title: Two to six hypercontractivity
statement: Let $S=\{-1,1\}$ have the uniform probability distribution, and let $X(s)=s$. For every $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the uniform $L^6$ norm of $a+bX/\sqrt{5}$ is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $a+bX$.
